About Us
HRUI is a national high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and development, production, sales, and service of intelligent network communication products such as PoE switches, industrial switches, and media converters, providing customers with industry-leading solutions for the development and production of network communication products.
The company has a complete R&D management system and an experienced technical R&D team, and has a well-equipped new product development laboratory and a reliability laboratory. The entire series of products have independent intellectual property rights and have passed CCC, CE, FCC, RoHS, etc international certification, meet the requirements of industry standards for security, transportation, power, energy, etc.
Explore More
Solution
Urban Sewage Treatment And Control System Solution
Urban sewage treatment refers to the measures taken to change the nature of sewage so that it does not harm the environmental waters. Urban sewage treatment technology is to use a variety of facilities and equipment and technology, the sewage contained pollution substances from the water separation and removal, so that the harmful substances into harmless substances, useful substances, water is purified, and make full use of resources.
Urban Comprehensive Pipe Gallery System Solution
Underground comprehensive pipe gallery is a kind of public infrastructure formed by placing two or more pipelines in it. It is the development direction of urban lifeline engineering infrastructure.The Underground comprehensive pipe gallery system not only solves the problem of urban traffic congestion, but also tremendous facilitates the maintenance and repair of municipal facilities such as power, communication, gas, water supply and drainage.
Industrial Automation Control System Solution
Industrial automation is the machine equipment or production process in the absence of direct manual intervention, according to the expected goal to achieve measurement, manipulation and other information processing and process control. Automation technology is to explore and research the method and technology to realize automation process. It is involved in machinery, microelectronics, computer, machine vision and other technical fields of a comprehensive technology.
Coal Mine Integrated Automation System Solution
Most coal mines have built or will build a variety of automation systems, from the point of view of system engineering on the whole to carry on the unified automatic management of the mine, prevent the "information island" phenomenon, effectively integrate all kinds of resources and give play to the maximum benefit of automation integration, it is necessary to establish a unified coal mine integrated automation system.
Electricity Distribution Automation System Solution
The large-scale power system that emerged in the 20th century is one of the most important achievements in the history of human engineering science. It is an electric power production and consumption system composed of power generation, transmission, substation, distribution and utilization. It transforms primary energy in nature into electricity through mechanical energy devices, and then supplies power to users through transmission, substation and distribution.
Highway Industry Monitoring Solutions
While the expressway network makes outstanding contribution to the national economic development, it also poses a severe test to the automation and intelligence of expressway management and operation. With the development of communication technology and electronic technology, electromechanical system of expressway has gradually become the basis of expressway management and operation.
Community Comprehensive Security System Solution
At present, community residents not only pursue high quality of life, but also pay special attention to the safety of life and property protection. Security system has become the basic configuration of intelligent community information system construction. The community security system provides wired and wireless integrated transmission and PoE power supply solutions to make community management more efficient, secure, and intelligent.
Large-scale Wireless Networking Solution
Wireless network refers to the network that can realize the interconnection of various communication devices without wiring. 1.
The principle of cooperation
Fairness and unity, mutual complementarity, mutual benefit and win-win.
2.
Sales model
In order to shorten circulation channels as much as possible, reduce intermediate links, facilitate management and minimize costs, and provide partners with maximum development and profit margins, HRUI mainly use agents to expand the market. At present, agent sales have become a main sales channel for the marketing of our products.
3.
Qualification requirements and responsibilities of agents
01. An independent legal entity. The "business scope" registered with the Administration for Industry and Commerce includes security, communications product sales, security, communications technology services, etc.
02. There is an independent office space. After becoming our agent, we need to open up a dedicated space to display our company's products and display promotional materials, and a dedicated person is responsible.
03. Have at least 1 year of business experience and a good company image. Experience in system integration and solution sales.
04. Agree to actively sell our series of products and actively cooperate with the company to develop the market. Have a complete company organizational structure, as well as a sales and service team dedicated to selling our series of products.
05. The business is concentrated in the security market. Have a stable customer base and have an in-depth understanding of customers.
06. In the security communication products, we mainly sell our company's series of products.
07. Comply with the channel business regulations of our series of products. Accept our company's coordination of product quotations in multiple competitions.
08. Regularly participate in our company's marketing activities, promotional activities and related training.
09. According to the agency agreement, HRUI is entrusted to provide technical support and after-sales service to local users or contractors.
10. According to the agency agreement, complete the specified sales volume within the agreement period (tentatively one year).
11. If the sales volume can't be completed within the agreement period, our company can handle it according to the specific contract.
4.
Agents enjoy rights
(1) The technical support that the agent can obtain from HRUI
01.
Product technical training.
02.
Assist in the production of complete plans and tenders.
03.
Solution assistance for project implementation and maintenance.
04.
24-hour real-time technical consultation acceptance (telephone, telex, online consultation, etc.).
05.
The 24-hour market service hotline provides various market services at any time.
(2) The market support that the agent can obtain from HRUI
01.
Free access to market information resources.
02.
Support for marketing activities and product advertisements.
03.
Market assessment assistance and continuous improvement suggestions.
5.
Guarantee of the rights and interests of agents
01.
Provide high-quality communication products.
02.
Increase marketing efforts and establish a strong brand image.
03.
In principle, HRUI don't directly supply to local terminals.
6.
Agent‘s commitment
Our company have strict regional division policy. All distributors or individuals can only operate in the area where they have obtained the qualification of distribution, and cannot sell across regions, otherwise they will all be regarded as fleeing goods.

Company Profile
Shenzhen Hongrui Optical Technology Company Ltd. is an innovative high-tech enterprise established in 2013 in Shenzhen, China. We focus on the R&D, production, sales, and service of intelligent network communication products, including PoE switches, managed switches, data center switches, industrial switches, enterprise-grade wireless APs, wireless bridges, and media converters, delivering industry-leading solutions for the development and production of network communication products. Our annual growth rate is over 30%, and annual R&D investment exceeds 25%. Our main R&D staff come from leading first-tier brands in the industry, with more than 17 years of experience!
With a complete R&D management system, an experienced technical R&D team, and well-equipped laboratories and testing machines, we offer industry-leading products for network communication solutions. All series of products have independent intellectual property rights, passed CQC, CE, FCC, RoHS and other international certifications, and meet the requirements of security, transportation, power, energy and other industry standards.
Covering more than 12,000 square meters, our manufacturing facilities feature a comprehensive range of advanced FUJI SMT machinery along with online inspection systems, complemented by a modern production laboratory. Our strict quality control ensures all products meet high standards, achieving an annual production capacity of over 3 million units. With a strong market reputation worldwide.
In the future, HRUI will continue to innovate in the field of PoE technology, adhering to the mission of “Providing the Most Competitive Networking Products for Global Customers”, and better serve customers around the world with better products and advanced technology.

2025
Manufacturing Upgrade, Focused on Industry Networking

· Multiple well-known brands as JDM/ODM/OEM partners

· HRUI Cloud APP officially launched, sharing a smart future
2023
Factory Upgrade
· New MES system implemented
· Expanded to 12,000 square meters
· Leading in the shipping of 2.5G switches
· Started developing 1000G data center switches
· Targeting an annual production capacity of over 2 million units
2021
Forge Ahead Unflinchingly
· Annual performance achieved a record high with over 70% growth.
· Factory expansion of 2,000 square meters completed.
· Increased investment in R&D led to the development of a complete series of 10G managed switches.
· Entry into overseas markets established.
· Participation in national intelligent transportation projects initiated.
· Global business expansion further enhanced.
2020
Brand Upgrade, Self-produced Power Supply
· The brand logo has been upgraded, the brand image has been improved.
· Independently researched and developed power supplies for mass production and use, and their stability is well received by customers.
· Software successfully docked with cloud management platform.
· The factory moved to an area of 6000㎡.
· During the Covid-19, the annual performance growth still exceeded 40%.
2019
Set Sail to Overseas Countries, New Products Continue

5 Years, the Original Intention Remains Unchanged
· PoE switches sales performance continues to increase, with annual growth exceeding 50%.
· Significant improvements in quality control and overall production efficiency.

· Set a vision for a future IPO and aims to be an industry criterion.

· Promote cultural construction, implement salary reform, standardize recruitment process, establish conference system, sort out organizational structure, implement
performance appraisal, and establish training system.
· Establish a manufacturing center to manage the delivery link in a unified manner.
· Expansion of the factory, adding an area of 1200㎡, total 2700㎡.

· Implant military quality and develop R&D concepts for stability.

· The relocation area of the factory is 2500㎡.

· Set up various functional departments, start operating the enterprise systematically.

Team Expansion

· New product line of optical fiber switches and telephone optical transceivers.

Founding Story
In 2009, Allen Du, who graduated with a major in network engineering, came to Shenzhen, Guangdong alone. As a network engineer, he is always in touch with all kinds of switch equipment. The feedback of most foreign terminal customers is that the quality of big brand switches is good, but the price is too expensive; the switches of other small brand manufacturers are cheap but of poor quality , and after-sales service is even more unacceptable.
After visiting dozens of switch manufacturers, large and small, and cooperating with several switch manufacturers. He found that the switch products on the market generally have serious premiums for big brands, unstable and lack of technical support for small-brand products, which are far from the customers' demand for high cost performance, stability and durability, and perfect after-sales.
After that, he found the direction, determined to establish a switch company recognized by the world, through his own strong R&D and quality control capabilities to change the industry's existing ills, and change the inherent "cheap, low-level, and lack of" foreign customers to Chinese manufacturers. The stereotype of "technology" made the world recognize China's communication equipment, and eventually all fell in love with China's communication equipment.
In 2013, after he told his friend Tang Lingjun, who has many years of experience in switch research and development, of his ideas, the two hit it off and immediately founded "HRUI". Urban Sewage Treatment And Control System Solution
Urban sewage treatment refers to the measures taken to change the nature of sewage so that it does not harm the environmental waters. Urban sewage treatment technology is to use a variety of facilities and equipment and technology, the sewage contained pollution substances from the water separation and removal, so that the harmful substances into harmless substances, useful substances, water is purified, and make full use of resources.

Urban Comprehensive Pipe Gallery System Solution
Underground comprehensive pipe gallery is a kind of public infrastructure formed by placing two or more pipelines in it. It is the development direction of urban lifeline engineering infrastructure.The Underground comprehensive pipe gallery system not only solves the problem of urban traffic congestion, but also tremendous facilitates the maintenance and repair of municipal facilities such as power, communication, gas, water supply and drainage.
Read More >>
Industrial Automation Control System Solution
Industrial automation is the machine equipment or production process in the absence of direct manual intervention, according to the expected goal to achieve measurement, manipulation and other information processing and process control. Automation technology is to explore and research the method and technology to realize automation process. It is involved in machinery, microelectronics, computer, machine vision and other technical fields of a comprehensive technology.
Read More >>
Coal Mine Integrated Automation System Solution
Most coal mines have built or will build a variety of automation systems, from the point of view of system engineering on the whole to carry on the unified automatic management of the mine, prevent the "information island" phenomenon, effectively integrate all kinds of resources and give play to the maximum benefit of automation integration, it is necessary to establish a unified coal mine integrated automation system.
Read More >>
Electricity Distribution Automation System Solution
The large-scale power system that emerged in the 20th century is one of the most important achievements in the history of human engineering science. It is an electric power production and consumption system composed of power generation, transmission, substation, distribution and utilization. It transforms primary energy in nature into electricity through mechanical energy devices, and then supplies power to users through transmission, substation and distribution.
Read More >>
Highway Industry Monitoring Solutions
While the expressway network makes outstanding contribution to the national economic development, it also poses a severe test to the automation and intelligence of expressway management and operation. With the development of communication technology and electronic technology, electromechanical system of expressway has gradually become the basis of expressway management and operation.
Read More >>
Community Comprehensive Security System Solution
At present, community residents not only pursue high quality of life, but also pay special attention to the safety of life and property protection. Security system has become the basic configuration of intelligent community information system construction. The community security system provides wired and wireless integrated transmission and PoE power supply solutions to make community management more efficient, secure, and intelligent.
Read More >>
Large-scale Wireless Networking Solution
Wireless network refers to the network that can realize the interconnection of various communication devices without wiring. In recent years, the development of wireless network is very rapid, and people‘s dependence on it is also gradually increasing. People prefer wireless networks to mobile networks because they are fast and easy to connect to.

2025
Manufacturing Upgrade, Focused on Industry Networking
· Full-process controlled by MES
· SPI, AOl, and X-RAY upgraded
· Industrial application centralized
· R&D investment increased
· Industrial switches shipping increase over 50%,

Partnerships and Innovations for a Smart Future
· Multiple well-known brands as JDM/ODM/OEM partners
· SMT equipment upgrade

· HRUI Cloud APP officially launched, sharing a smart future
2023
Factory Upgrade
· New MES system implemented
· Expanded to 12,000 square meters
· Leading in the shipping of 2.5G switches
· Started developing 1000G data center switches
· Targeting an annual production capacity of over 2 million units
2021
Forge Ahead Unflinchingly
· Annual performance achieved a record high with over 70% growth.
· Factory expansion of 2,000 square meters completed.
· Increased investment in R&D led to the development of a complete series of 10G managed switches.
· Entry into overseas markets established.
· Participation in national intelligent transportation projects initiated.
· Global business expansion further enhanced.
2020
Brand Upgrade, Self-produced Power Supply
· The brand logo has been upgraded, the brand image has been improved.
· Independently researched and developed power supplies for mass production and use, and their stability is well received by customers.
· Software successfully docked with cloud management platform.
· The factory moved to an area of 6000㎡.
· During the Covid-19, the annual performance growth still exceeded 40%.
2019
Set Sail to Overseas Countries, New Products Continue
· Intensify overseas promotion, and the annual performance of the Ministry of Foreign Trade increased by 98%.
· Launched Genius series PoE switches, 2.5G industrial switches, BT90W PoE switches and PoE Injector.
· Self-developed power supply has entered the trial production stage.
· 10G core switches entered the trial production stage.
2018
5 Years, the Original Intention Remains Unchanged
· PoE switches sales performance continues to increase, with annual growth exceeding 50%.
· Significant improvements in quality control and overall production efficiency.
· Investment made in SMT factory.
· Celebrated the 5th anniversary and set a goal to reach 1 billion in annual sales within 5 years.
· Set a vision for a future IPO and aims to be an industry criterion.
2017
Management Year
· Promote cultural construction, implement salary reform, standardize recruitment process, establish conference system, sort out organizational structure, implement
performance appraisal, and establish training system.
· Establish a manufacturing center to manage the delivery link in a unified manner.
· Expansion of the factory, adding an area of 1200㎡, total 2700㎡.
2016
Honor Year
· New product line of industrial-grade switches.
· Implant military quality and develop R&D concepts for stability.
· Won the national high-tech enterprise, 3 utility model patents, 8 soft works and 3 appearance patents, etc.
· The annual performance of the Ministry of Foreign Trade increased by 174%.
· The relocation area of the factory is 2500㎡.
2015
Performance Take Off
· Factory relocated, covering an area of 1500㎡.
· New product line: PoE switch, HD optical transceiver.
· Set up various functional departments, start operating the enterprise systematically.
· Annual performance growth rate reached 85%.
2014
Team Expansion
· Establish the e-commerce department and the foreign trade department.
· New product line of optical fiber switches and telephone optical transceivers.
2013
Founded
· Mainly produce video optical transceivers and Media converters.

Founding Story
In 2009, Allen Du, who graduated with a major in network engineering, came to Shenzhen, Guangdong alone. As a network engineer, he is always in touch with all kinds of switch equipment. The feedback of most foreign terminal customers is that the quality of big brand switches is good, but the price is too expensive; the switches of other small brand manufacturers are cheap but of poor quality , and after-sales service is even more unacceptable.
After visiting dozens of switch manufacturers, large and small, and cooperating with several switch manufacturers. He found that the switch products on the market generally have serious premiums for big brands, unstable and lack of technical support for small-brand products, which are far from the customers' demand for high cost performance, stability and durability, and perfect after-sales.
After that, he found the direction, determined to establish a switch company recognized by the world, through his own strong R&D and quality control capabilities to change the industry's existing ills, and change the inherent "cheap, low-level, and lack of" foreign customers to Chinese manufacturers. The stereotype of "technology" made the world recognize China's communication equipment, and eventually all fell in love with China's communication equipment.
In 2013, after he told his friend Tang Lingjun, who has many years of experience in switch research and development, of his ideas, the two hit it off and immediately founded "HRUI". Since the moment the brand was born, HRUI has taken "Providing The Most Competitive Networking Products For Global Customers" as its mission, "becoming a benchmark enterprise in the intelligent network communication industry" as its vision, and has always been "pursuing excellence and creating legends;" Create greater value for customers, provide a platform for employees to realize their dreams, and make due contributions to the society" is the concept of business development.
After years of precipitation, HRUI has now developed into a well-known manufacturer in the industry that can provide overall solutions for intelligent network communication products by integrating superior resources in the upstream and downstream industrial chains. HRUI is committed to providing one-stop services of software and hardware design, R&D, and production for domestic and foreign brands, so as to solve the problems of serious homogeneity of products in the switch market, lack of innovation in technology, and lack of technical support for many small and medium-sized brands, and help brand customers in More competitive in the high-end market.

Efficient. Scalable. Easy to Install.
HR-AFR-41+ is a Fast Ethernet PoE extender designed for expanding network and surveillance coverage. Featuring 1× 100Mbps PoE IN port and 4× 100Mbps PoE OUT ports, it extends both power and data over a single Ethernet cable — maximizing port density while minimizing installation costs. Supporting HiPoE 60W input and IEEE 802.3af/at PoE standards, it delivers stable power and 10/100M connectivity for IP cameras, access points, and other PoE-powered devices.
Compliant with IEEE 802.3, 802.3u, and 802.3x standards, the extender supports 10/100Mbps auto-negotiation, Auto MDI/MDIX, and a long-range mode (activated via DIP switch) that extends PoE and data transmission up to 250 meters at 10Mbps. Real-time LED status indicators enable quick fault analysis. With flexible desktop, wall-mount, or DIN-rail installation, the HR-AFR-41+ is ideal for multi-device deployments such as hotels, schools, parking lots, and large-scale surveillance projects.
Product Highlights
• 1*100Mbps PoE in port+4*100Mbps PoE out ports.
• Comply with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3u, and IEEE 802.3x standards.
• Support HiPoE 60W in.
• Support IEEE802.3af/at power supply standard.
• Ethernet Ports support 10/100Mbps self-adaptive.
• The panel indicator LEDs will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis.
• Support automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX).
• Support Extend mode.
• Having network and PoE relay extension roles.
• Flow control method, full duplex adopts IEEE 802.3x standard, and half duplex adopts Back pressure standard.

The HRUI AI PoE switches provide a range of models featuring both 100M/Gigabit PoE, RJ45, and SFP uplink ports. These switches meet the IEEE 802.3af/at standards for Power over Ethernet, with PoE ports capable of 30W. The devices offer three working modes: Default, VLAN (Port Isolation), and Extend. Additionally, the series supports PoE watchdog functionality in both VLAN and Extend modes, enabling the detection and automatic reboot of unresponsive or dropped PoE-powered devices.
With user-friendly installation and maintenance processes, these switches help establish a secure and high-performance network. HRUI AI PoE switches are ideal for various Ethernet access applications, including small to medium-sized enterprises, internet cafes, hotels, and schools.
FEATURES
• Power Over Ethernet
This series of switches provides PoE ports, compliant with IEEE 802.3af/at, enabling simultaneous data and power transmission to devices via a single, convenient Ethernet cable. By integrating power delivery into a single cable, these switches streamline cabling infrastructure and eliminate the need for separate power sources, thereby providing an efficient and cost-effective solution for powering network devices.
• Advanced Functions with DIP Switch
VLAN:
Downlink ports are isolated from each other, but can still communicate with uplink ports. This mode also enables PoE watchdog on ports.
Default:
All ports support communication with each other, with a transmission distance of up to 100 meters and an adaptive speed of 10/100/1000Mbps. This mode disables PoE watchdog on ports.
Extend:
The downlink PoE & data transmission distance of port 7-8 can reach up to 250 meters, with a speed of 10Mbps. This mode enables PoE watchdog on ports.
• AI PoE Watchdog
Detect and reboot dropped or unresponsive PoE-powered devices.
• Safe PoE Smart Boot-up
Support PoE Smart Boot-up that enables PoE on ports from the first to last in sequence to prevent damage to the power supply by sudden large currents. The function is enabled by default.
• Plug and Play, Easy to Use
All Ethernet ports on our switches support MDI/MDIX compatibility, allowing for easy setup with no software installation or configuration needed.
• 19 Inch Rack Mout
• High Reliable Design
Support installed in a standard rack environment, easy to integrate with other equipment and manage cabling.
Support 4KV surge and 8KV ESD protection.
Features and Highlights
• 8* 1G PoE ports+1 *1G uplink port+1 *1G SFP port
• Complies with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, and IEEE 802.3x standards
• RJ45 port supports 10M/100M/1G adaptive
• PoE port automatically activates PoE watchdog mode in VLAN and Extend modes
• Flow control method: Full duplex uses IEEE 802.3x standard, while half duplex uses Back pressure standard
• The panel indicator LED will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
• Supports 1-8 port PoE power supply priority, with ports in the top priority being higher

How to Choose Between 1Gbps, 2.5Gbps, and 10Gbps Ethernet Switches?
2026-07-10
A Practical Guide to Selecting the Right Network Speed for Different Applications
With increasing demand for high-speed networking, choosing the right Ethernet switch speed has become an important decision for businesses. While 1Gbps switches remain widely used, 2.5Gbps and 10Gbps switches are becoming more popular for applications such as Wi-Fi 6, high-resolution video, cloud services, and data-intensive workloads.
This guide explains the differences between
1Gbps, 2.5Gbps, and 10Gbps
Ethernet switches and helps you select the right solution based on your network requirements.
1Gbps vs 2.5Gbps vs 10Gbps Switch: Key Differences
The main difference between these switches is network bandwidth capacity.
Switch Speed
Maximum Data Rate
Typical Applications
1Gbps Switch
1 Gigabit per second
Small offices, basic surveillance, VoIP, general networking
2.5Gbps Switch
2.5 Gigabits per second
Wi-Fi 6/6E APs, NAS, high-speed workstations, SMB networks
10Gbps Switch
10 Gigabits per second
Enterprise backbone, servers, data centers, large-scale networks
When Should You Choose a 1Gbps Switch?
A 1Gbps Ethernet switch is still a reliable choice for many standard network environments.
It is suitable for:
Small and medium-sized businesses
IP camera systems
Office computers and printers
VoIP communication systems
Basic network access
Advantages of 1Gbps Switches
Cost-effective
Easy deployment
Compatible with existing Ethernet devices
Suitable for most everyday networking needs
However, Gigabit Ethernet may become a limitation when multiple users transfer large files, deploy high-performance wireless networks, or require higher bandwidth applications.
Why Choose a 2.5Gbps Switch?
2.5Gbps switch
provides higher bandwidth without requiring a complete network upgrade.
It has become increasingly popular due to the adoption of
Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 6E access points,
which can exceed the performance limits of traditional Gigabit Ethernet.
Typical applications include:
Wi-Fi 6/6E wireless networks
High-speed NAS storage
Video production environments
Engineering workstations
Growing SMB networks
Benefits of 2.5Gbps Switching
Provides 2.5× more bandwidth than Gigabit Ethernet
Supports many existing Cat5e cabling environments
More affordable than full 10Gbps deployment
Provides a future-ready network upgrade path
For businesses looking for improved performance without significantly increasing infrastructure costs, 2.5Gbps is often the ideal choice.
When Do You Need a 10Gbps Switch?
10Gbps Ethernet switch
is designed for high-performance networks requiring large data throughput and low latency.
Common applications include:
Enterprise core networks
Data centers
Server rooms
Storage networks
AI and high-performance computing environments
Large-scale video surveillance systems
Benefits of 10Gbps Switching
High bandwidth capacity
Reduced network congestion
Faster data transfer between servers and storage
Better scalability for future applications
In many networks, 10Gbps switches are deployed as backbone or aggregation switches, while edge devices continue using 1Gbps or 2.5Gbps connections.
How to Choose the Right Ethernet Switch Speed?
Before selecting a switch, consider the following factors:
1. Application Requirements
Different applications require different bandwidth levels.
Application
Recommended Speed
Office networking
1Gbps
Basic IP surveillance
1Gbps
Wi-Fi 6 deployment
2.5Gbps
Large file transfer
2.5Gbps / 10Gbps
Server and data center networks
10Gbps
2. Number of Connected Devices
More users and devices create higher network traffic.
For growing networks, selecting switches with higher-speed uplinks, such as 2.5G or 10G uplinks, can improve network efficiency and provide better expansion capability.
3. Future Network Expansion
Network equipment is usually deployed for several years. Choosing a switch with additional bandwidth capacity can help avoid frequent hardware replacement as business requirements grow.
1Gbps, 2.5Gbps, or 10Gbps: Which One Is Right for You?
There is no universal answer—the best choice depends on your applications, network size, and future plans.
Choose
1Gbps switches
for standard office networks and basic applications.
Choose
2.5Gbps switches
for Wi-Fi 6, high-speed devices, and modern SMB networks.
Choose
10Gbps switches
for enterprise backbone, servers, and data-intensive environments.
By selecting the right Ethernet switch speed, businesses can achieve a balance between performance, reliability, and investment.

What Is a PoE Injector? A Complete Guide to How It Works and When to Use One
2026-07-13
Learn how a PoE injector works, when it is the right choice, and how it compares with a PoE switch for modern network deployments.
Power over Ethernet (PoE) has become a standard technology for powering IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other network devices through a single Ethernet cable. While PoE switches are widely used, not every network requires replacing an existing switch.
In many cases,
a PoE injector
provides a simple and cost-effective way to add PoE capability without changing the existing network infrastructure.
This guide explains what a PoE injector is, how it works, and when it is the right solution for your network.
What Is a PoE Injector?
A PoE injector
, also known as a
Power over Ethernet injector
, is a device that combines electrical power and Ethernet data into a single network cable. It enables a standard,
non-PoE switch or router to power PoE-compatible devices without replacing existing networking equipment.
Typical powered devices include:
IP Cameras
Wireless Access Points (AP)
VoIP Phones
IoT Devices
Video Intercom Systems
How Does a PoE Injector Work?
A PoE injector sits between the network switch and the powered device.
The process is straightforward:
1. A non-PoE switch sends Ethernet data to the injector.
2. The injector adds electrical power to the Ethernet cable.
3. The cable carries both power and data to the powered device.
For IEEE 802.3af/at/bt compliant injectors, the injector first performs a detection and power-classification process to confirm that the connected device supports PoE before supplying power. This protects non-PoE devices from accidental damage.
PoE Injector vs. PoE Switch
Although both devices deliver power over E
thernet, they are designed for different deployment needs.
Feature
PoE Injector
PoE Switch
PoE Ports
Usually 1
Multiple
Existing Switch Required
Yes
No
Best For
Adding PoE to one or a few devices
New or large PoE deployments
Initial Investment
Lower
Higher
Network Expansion
Limited
Highly scalable
If only a few PoE devices need to be added to an existing network, a PoE injector is often the more economical solution. For larger deployments with many powered devices, a PoE switch offers centralized power management and easier expansion.
When Should You Use a PoE Injector?
A PoE injector is an ideal choice in several common scenarios:
Upgrade an Existing Network
If your current Ethernet switch does not support PoE, an injector allows you to power compatible devices without replacing the switch.
Small Deployments
For installations with one or two IP cameras or wireless access points, a PoE injector provides a simple and practical solution.
Reduce Upgrade Costs
Replacing an entire switch solely to support a few PoE devices may not be cost-effective. An injector can significantly reduce deployment costs while delivering the required functionality.
Common PoE Standards
Choosing the correct injector depends on the power requirements of the connected device.
IEEE Standard
Maximum Power
Typical Devices
IEEE 802.3af
15.4 W
VoIP Phones, Basic IP Cameras
IEEE 802.3at (PoE+)
30 W
PTZ Cameras, Wi-Fi Access Points
IEEE 802.3bt (PoE++)
60–90 W
Wi-Fi 6/7 APs, Industrial Devices, High-Power Cameras
All IEEE PoE standards are backward compatible, allowing newer injectors to support many lower-power PoE devices.
Standard PoE vs. Passive PoE Injectors
Not all PoE injectors operate in the same way.
Standard (Active) PoE Injectors
IEEE 802.3af/at/bt compliant
Automatically detect compatible devices
Supply power only after successful negotiation
Recommended for most enterprise and commercial networks
Passive PoE Injectors
No automatic detection
Output a fixed voltage continuously
Designed only for devices that specifically support passive PoE
Using a passive injector with incompatible equipment may damage connected devices, so compatibility should always be verified before deployment.
How to Choose the Right PoE Injector？
Before purchasing a PoE injector, consider the following factors:
PoE Standard
– Select IEEE 802.3af, 802.3at, or 802.3bt according to device power requirements.
Network Speed
– Ensure support for Fast Ethernet, Gigabit, 2.5G, 5G, or 10G if required.
Power Output
– Match the injector's output to the connected powered device.
Future Expansion
– Higher-power, multi-gig injectors can better support future network upgrades.
A PoE injector provides a simple and cost-effective way to add Power over Ethernet capability to an existing non-PoE network. It enables both power and data to be delivered over a single Ethernet cable, eliminating the need for additional power outlets while supporting devices such as IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other IEEE 802.3af/at/bt compliant powered devices.
For small and medium-sized deployments, a PoE injector provides an efficient balance between flexibility, performance, and investment.
For larger installations with many powered devices, a dedicated PoE switch may be the better long-term solution.Selecting the right PoE standard, power level, and network speed will help ensure reliable operation and support future network growth.

Switch vs Hub vs Router: Which One Do You Really Need?
2026-07-27
Whether you're building a home network, deploying IP surveillance, or upgrading an office LAN, you'll eventually face one question:
Should I use a hub, a switch, or a router?
Although these devices all connect network equipment, they serve
completely different purposes. Choosing the wrong one can limit performance, reduce security, and create unnecessary network bottlenecks.
In this g
uide, we'll explain the differences in plain English—with practical examples instead of technical jargon.
At a Glance
Device
Primary Function
Best For
Hub
Broadca
sts data to every device
Legacy networks (rarely used today)
Switch
Sends data only to the intended device
Homes, offices, surveillance, enterprise LANs
Router
Connects different networks and provides Internet access
Connecting LAN to WAN or multiple networks
Quick takeaway:
hub shares
, a
switch directs
, and a
router decides the path
What Is a Hub?
hub
is the most basic networking device.
Think of it as a loudspeaker in a room. Whenever one device sends data, the hub repeats that information to
every connected device
, whether they need it or not.
Instead of broadcasting traffic everywhere, it learns the
MAC address
of each connected device and remembers which port each device uses.
How it works
If Computer A wants to send data to Computer B, the hub doesn't know which port Computer B is connected to.
Instead, it simply forwards the data to
all ports
Every connected device receives the packet and checks whether it is the intended recipient.
Advantages
Low cost
Simple to install
No configuration required
Limitations
Heavy network congestion
Shared bandwidth
Lower security
Poor scalability
Because every device shares the same communication channel, only one transmission can occur at a time.
Today, hubs have almost disappeared from modern networks.
What Is a Switch?
network switch

PoE Switch for IP Cameras: How to Choose the Right CCTV Network Switch?
2026-07-29
A PoE switch is the preferred network switch for most IP camera systems. It delivers power and data through one Ethernet cable, simplifying installation and reducing cabling costs.
To choose the right PoE switch for CCTV, focus on five factors: PoE budget, port count, uplink speed, management features, and installation environment.
Calculate the PoE Budget
Check the maximum power consumption of every camera before selecting a switch.
Fixed cameras usually use standard PoE or PoE+. PTZ cameras, infrared cameras, and cameras with heaters may require higher power. Use the camera’s maximum rated power—not only its normal operating power—to calculate the total requirement.
Required PoE budget = total camera power + power reserve
A power reserve helps maintain stable operation when IR lighting, PTZ movement, or additional cameras increase the load.
Select Enough PoE Ports
Choose a switch with enough ports for the current system and future expansion.
Up to 8 cameras: 8-port PoE switch
8–16 cameras: 16-port PoE switch
16–24 cameras: 24-port PoE switch
Larger projects: multiple PoE switches with fiber uplinks
Selecting spare ports now can reduce upgrade costs later.
Choose the Right Uplink Speed
A Gigabit PoE switch is a practical choice for most modern CCTV systems. It supports high-resolution cameras and provides sufficient bandwidth for small and medium projects.
For larger systems, multiple 4K cameras, or several access switches, choose a switch with Gigabit SFP fiber uplinks or higher-speed uplinks. This helps prevent bottlenecks between the camera network, NVR, and core network.
Fiber uplinks are also suitable for long-distance connections between buildings or outdoor surveillance locations.
Managed or Unmanaged PoE Switch?
An unmanaged PoE switch is suitable for simple, small-scale CCTV systems. It is easy to deploy and requires no configuration.
A managed PoE switch is recommended for enterprise surveillance, campuses, smart buildings, and multi-switch networks. Key functions may include:
VLAN isolation for separating camera traffic
PoE monitoring and remote camera restart
Traffic management for improved network control
Remote management and fault diagnosis
For professional surveillance systems, managed PoE switching improves visibility and simplifies maintenance.
Match the Switch to the Environment
Commercial PoE switches are suitable for offices, shops, hotels, and indoor camera installations.
For factories, transportation systems, outdoor cabinets, and other demanding locations, use an industrial PoE switch. Industrial models are designed for harsh environments and typically provide wider operating temperatures, stronger surge protection, and more robust hardware.
Plan for Long-Distance Cameras
Standard Ethernet cable runs are typically limited to 100 meters. For remote cameras in parking areas, warehouses, campuses, or industrial sites, consider:
PoE Extend Mode
PoE extenders
Fiber uplinks
Industrial PoE switches near the camera location
These options help maintain stable power and network connectivity over longer distances.
HRUI PoE Switches for CCTV Systems
HRUI provides PoE switches for IP camera and surveillance applications, including desktop, rack-mounted, managed, and industrial models.
Depending on the model, HRUI PoE switches offer Gigabit ports, SFP uplinks, PoE priority, VLAN isolation, Extend Mode, and PoE Watchdog. These functions help installers build reliable and scalable CCTV networks for indoor, outdoor, and industrial applications.
Conclusion
The right PoE switch for IP cameras provides enough power, sufficient ports, reliable uplinks, and features suited to the installation environment.
Before purchasing, confirm the PoE budget, camera quantity, uplink requirement, management needs, and transmission distance. This will help ensure stable video transmission and easier long-term maintenance.

What Is Access Point Mode and How to Use It for Your Wi-Fi Network?

As Wi-Fi networks expand from homes to offices, hotels, campuses, and commercial sites, a single wireless router may not provide sufficient coverage for every area.
One practical solution is to add one or more
Wireless
Access Points (APs)
to the existing network. For compatible routers,
Access Point Mode
provides another way to extend Wi-Fi without creating an additional routed network.
So, what is Access Point Mode, how does it differ from Router Mode, and when should you use it?
This guide explains the basics and provides a practical reference for network installers, system integrators, distributors, and IT professionals.
What
Is an Access Point
A Wireless Access Point, commonly called an AP, is a network device that provides Wi-Fi access to wireless clients and connects them to an existing wired network.
A typical deployment looks like:
Internet → Router/Firewall → Switch → Access Point → Wi-Fi Devices
The router or firewall handles network gateway functions such as routing, NAT, and DHCP, while the AP focuses on providing wireless connectivity.
Dedicated APs are commonly deployed in offices, commercial buildings, schools, hotels, and other environments where multiple areas require reliable Wi-Fi coverage.
Modern APs are available in different Wi-Fi generations, including Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7, providing options for different network requirements and deployment scenarios.
What Is Access Point Mode?
Ac
ess Point Mode is an
opcer
ating mode that allows a compatible router or wireless device to work as an access point instead of acting as a separate router.
When AP Mode is enabled, functions such as routing, NAT, and DHCP are generally disabled or handled by the upstream router. The device connects to the existing LAN and provides Wi-Fi access to connected clients.
In simple terms:
Router Mode:
The device manages the network.
Access Point Mode:
The device extends the existing network through Wi-Fi.
This makes AP Mode useful when an existing router or gateway is already in place but additional wireless coverage is required.

modes is im

when deploying multiple network devices.

The exact functions available in AP Mode vary by device and firmware, so the manufacturer's specifications should always be checked before configuration.
How Does Access Point Mode Work?
In a typical network, the main router remains the gateway, while the AP provides wireless access.
Internet → Main Router → PoE Switch → AP → Wireless Clients
For example, an office may already have a router and Ethernet network but experience weak Wi-Fi coverage in meeting rooms or other areas.
Instead of adding another router and creating another network, an AP can be connected to the existing LAN to provide additional Wi-Fi coverage.
For professional deployments, APs can also be powered through
PoE
, allowing both network connectivity and power to be delivered through a single Ethernet cable.
How to Configure Access Point Mode
The exact steps vary by manufacturer, but the general process is straightforward.
1. Connect the AP
to the Existing Network
Connect the AP to the existing router or network switch using Ethernet.
For PoE-compatible APs, a PoE switch or PoE injector can provide power through the Ethernet connection.
2. Select Access Point Mode
Log in to th
e device's management interface and select
Access Point Mode
or the corresponding operating mode.
On some devices, AP Mode is available directly under the operation mode settings.
3. Configure the Wi-Fi Network
Set the required:
SSID
Wi-Fi password
Security settings
Wireless band
Channel and other radio settings
For multiple APs, consistent wireless settings can make network management easier
4. Check the Network Connection
After configuration, connect a wireless device to the AP and verify that it receives an IP address from the main router and can access the network normally.
When Should You Use Access Point Mode?
Expanding Wi-Fi Cov
erage
AP Mode is useful when an existing network needs additional Wi-Fi coverage without replacing the main router.
Typical applications include:
Offices
Commercial buildings
Hotels
Schools
Warehouses
Multi-floor buildings

oiding Mu
ltiple Routing Layers
Using multiple routers in Router Mode can create separate networks and may introduce issues such as double NAT.
Using AP Mode allows the main r
outer to remain responsible for network management while additional devices provide Wi-Fi access.
Building a Multi-AP Network
For larger deployments, multiple APs can be connected to the same wired network:
Router/Firewall → Network Switch → Multiple APs
This architecture is suitable for expanding Wi-Fi coverage across different rooms, fl
oors, or areas.
Access Point Mode vs. Wireless Repeater

An
Access Point
normally uses a wired network connection as its backhaul:
Wired Network → AP → Wi-Fi Clients
Wireless Repeater
receives an existing Wi-Fi signal and retransmits it to extend wireless coverage.
For professional network deployments, a wired AP connection is generally preferred when Ethernet cabling is available because it provides a dedicated wired backhaul.

Why Does a PoE Switch Keep Rebooting?
A PoE switch that repeatedly reboots can interrupt IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other connected devices.
Before replacing the equipment, first determine w
hether the switch itself is rebooting or only the connected PoE devices are restarting. This helps narrow down the possible causes.
Is the Switch or the PoE Device Re

Com
mon Causes
1. Unstable Power Supply
An unstable AC/DC input, loose connection, or faulty power adapter can cause the entire switch to restart.
Check the power cable, adapter, UPS, and power source. If possible, test with a known-good power supply.
2. Insufficient PoE Power Budget
A PoE switch has a total power budget for all connected devices.
For example, 10 devices requiring up to 20 W each may require:
10 × 20 W = 200 W
If the available PoE budget is insufficient, connected devices may fail to start or repeatedly lose power.
When designing a PoE network, calculate the maximum expected load and leave reasonable power headroom.
3. Overcurrent or Faulty PoE Device
A faulty IP camera, AP, or other powered device may draw excessive current. Some devices may also require more power during startup.
Disconnect the PoE devices and reconnect them one at a time. If the problem appears after connecting a specific device, test it on another known-good PoE port.
4. Faulty Ethernet Cable
Damaged cables, poor RJ45 terminations, loose connectors, or excessive cable length can cause unstable PoE delivery.
Try a short, known-good Ethernet cable. If the device becomes stable, inspect the original cable path.
For standard Ethernet deployments, the total copper link between the switch and device should generally remain within 100 m.
5. Overheating
High ambient temperature and insufficient ventilation can affect switch stability.
Check the cabinet ventilation, airflow, dust accumulation, and installation environment. For outdoor or harsh industrial applications, use equipment designed for the required operating temperature range.
6. Network Loops or Abnormal Traffic
A reboot-like symptom is not always caused by PoE.
Network loops, broadcast storms, or abnormal traffic can cause temporary connectivity loss, making a PoE device appear to have restarted.
Check the network topology, traffic conditions, and loop-protection settings.

If the problem persists, review logs and seek technical support.
What Is PoE Watchdog?
PoE Watchdog addresses a different problem:
the switch is working normally, but a connected PoE device becomes unresponsive.
On supported PoE switches, it can detect an unresponsive device and automatically restart power on the affected port. This is useful for remote IP cameras, wireless APs, and other unattended deployments.
PoE device becomes unresponsive → PoE Watchdog can restart the device
Entire switch loses power → Check power, thermal, and hardware conditions
Application Example: IP Camera Network
If several IP cameras repeatedly restart, check the
PoE budget, cables, individual cameras, PoE ports, temperature, and switch power
in sequence.
This helps determine whether the problem originates from the switch, camera, cable, or power system without unnecessarily replacing equipment.
For larger CCTV deployments, select a PoE switch with sufficient power capacity and appropriate port specifications for the connected devices.
FAQ
Q: Why does my PoE switch keep rebooting?
A: Common causes include unstable power, insufficient PoE capacity, overcurrent, faulty cables or devices, overheating, and network problems. First determine whether the entire switch or only the PoE devices are restarting.
Q: Can an insufficient PoE budget cause a switch to reboot?
A: An insufficient PoE budget usually causes connected devices to lose power or fail to start. If the entire switch is rebooting, also check its main power supply and thermal conditions.
Q: Why does my IP camera keep restarting?
A: Check the camera's power requirement, available PoE budget, Ethernet cable, PoE port, and possible overcurrent conditions.
Q: Can a bad Ethernet cable cause PoE problems?
A: Yes. Damaged cables, poor connections, and excessive cable length can cause unstable power delivery and intermittent connectivity.
Q: What is PoE Watchdog?
A: PoE Watchdog monitors connected PoE devices and can automatically restart a port when a powered device becomes unresponsive. It is useful for remote cameras, APs, and other unattended devices.

A rebooting PoE switch is not necessarily a hardware failure. Check the

systematically before replacing equipment.

Wi-Fi 7 Is Changing Enterprise Ethernet: Why Multi-Gigabit Switching Matters
2026-09-22
Wi-Fi 7 is moving into mainstream enterprise deployment, bringing higher wireless throughput and greater demands on the wired network behind each access point. As a result, upgrading the AP alone may not deliver the expected performance if the Ethernet infrastructure remains limited to Gigabit connections.
Does Wi-Fi 7 Require 2.5G Ethernet?
Not every Wi-Fi 7 deployment requires 2.5G Ethernet, but
2.5G is becoming a practical access speed for enterprise Wi-Fi 7 networks.
It provides more bandwidth than Gigabit Ethernet while supporting many existing copper cabling environments.
The 2026 Ethernet Alliance Roadmap identifies 2.5G, 5G and 10GBASE-T as important enterprise technologies for Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 networks.
For this reason, a typical high-performance deployment can be structured as:
Wi-Fi 7 AP → 2.5G Ethernet → Multi-Gigabit PoE Switch → 10G Uplink
Why Does Wi-Fi 7 Need 10G Uplinks?
The requirement comes from traffic aggregation. A switch connecting multiple 2.5G Wi-Fi 7 APs can quickly carry several gigabits of traffic toward the aggregation or core layer.
10G uplink
provides additional capacity and helps reduce oversubscription, particularly in high-density wireless environments. This makes uplink bandwidth an important consideration when selecting a switch for Wi-Fi 7.
What Type of Switch Is Needed for Wi-Fi 7?
There is no single switch specification for every deployment. The right switch should match the AP's bandwidth, power requirements and network density.
Key considerations include:
2.5G or higher Ethernet ports
PoE capacity
suitable for the selected APs
10G uplinks
for aggregated traffic
Compatible cabling
for the target Ethernet speed
Sufficient
switching capacity
for the deployment
Gigabit Ethernet can still support Wi-Fi 7 in lower-throughput scenarios, but it may limit the usable capacity of higher-performance APs.
As Wi-Fi 7 adoption expands, multi-gigabit switching is becoming an important part of enterprise wireless infrastructure.
The upgrade should therefore be considered end to end, from the AP and PoE access layer to the uplink and aggregation network.

Industrial Ethernet for AI-Powered Machine Vision: What the Network Needs to Handle
2026-09-23
AI-powered machine vision is moving beyond simple inspection tasks. In modern factories, cameras and sensors are increasingly used for defect detection, process monitoring, worker safety, and automated decision-making. As these applications become more data-intensive, the industrial network connecting cameras, edge systems, and control equipment becomes part of the performance equation.
So, what does an industrial Ethernet network need to handle AI-powered machine vision?
Higher Bandwidth at the Edge
Machine vision systems can generate continuous streams of high-resolution image and video data. When multiple cameras operate simultaneously, a traditional 1G connection may become a constraint, particularly when image data is processed or transferred at the edge.
The required Ethernet speed depends on camera resolution, frame rate, compression, and the number of connected devices. For higher-throughput applications,
2.5G, 5G, or 10G
Ethernet can provide additional capacity between cameras, edge computing systems, and aggregation switches.
This makes the access switch an important part of the machine vision architecture:
Industrial Cameras → PoE Switch → Edge Computing → Industrial Network
Does AI Machine Vision Require PoE?
Not necessarily, but PoE can simplify camera deployment by carrying both power and data over a single Ethernet cable. This is particularly useful when cameras are distributed across production lines, warehouses, or other industrial environments.
The switch should be selected according to the camera's power requirements, total PoE budget, port speed, and environmental conditions. For higher-power devices, PoE+ or higher-power PoE technologies may be required.
Why Do Latency and Reliability Matter?
Machine vision is often connected to real-time production processes. Delays or intermittent connectivity can affect how quickly image data reaches an edge system or control application.
For this reason, industrial Ethernet design should consider more than bandwidth.
Low and predictable latency, network redundancy, and rapid fault recovery
can be important in applications where continuous data transmission is required.
Managed industrial switches can support functions such as VLAN, QoS, ring redundancy, and traffic monitoring to help organize and protect machine vision traffic.
Designing the Network for Industrial AI
There is no single Ethernet specification for every AI-powered factory. Network requirements depend on the cameras, computing architecture, production process, and environmental conditions.
A practical design should evaluate:
Port speed:
1G, 2.5G, 5G, or 10G based on traffic requirements
PoE budget:
sufficient power for connected cameras and devices
Uplinks
adequate capacity between access and aggregation layers
Redundancy:
ring or dual-path architectures where required
Industrial protection:
temperature range, surge protection, and power redundancy
As AI moves closer to the factory floor, machine vision is becoming a networking challenge as well as a computing challenge. A well-designed industrial Ethernet infrastructure provides the bandwidth, power, and reliability needed to connect cameras with the systems that turn visual data into production decisions.

Mid-Autumn Festival with Exciting Activities at HRUI
2024-11-27
In celebration of the Mid-Autumn Festival, HRUI is excited to announce a half-day event packed with engaging activities meant to honor this traditional holiday and strengthen team spirit among employees. The festivities will take place from September 9 to 10, 2024, at the HRUI offices, running from 4:40 PM to 6:30 PM.
This year's celebration promises a mix of intellectual challenges and fun games, including:
Chinese Lantern Riddle:
Participants will put their wits to the test with cleverly crafted riddles displayed on beautiful lanterns, bringing a sense of nostalgia and excitement to the evening.
Tossing the Hu:
Employees will demonstrate their skills in this traditional Chinese game, where contestants aim to toss wooden sticks into a pot. Prizes will be awarded to the most accurate throwers!
The Order of the Flying Flower:
This lively competition invites participants to recite lines from classical poetry at a fast pace, encouraging creativity and quick thinking while celebrating Chinese literature.
Guess What:
Teams will enjoy a light-hearted guessing game where they must identify famous quotes from popular movies and TV shows.
Legend and Story Gathering:
Attendees can listen to ancient legends associated with the festival, appreciating the rich culture and history that spans a thousand years.
The event will also feature delicious mooncakes and refreshments, allowing everyone to soak in the festive atmosphere and connect with colleagues from various departments.
“We are thrilled to bring the spirit of the Mid-Autumn Festival to HRUI,” said Yang, Marketing Supervisor. “This event not only celebrates our cultural heritage but also strengthens our company culture by encouraging teamwork, creativity, and a bit of friendly competition.”
All employees are encouraged to take part in the activities, with prizes and recognition awarded to the winners of each challenge, ensuring a fun and memorable celebration. Join us as we celebrate unity, creativity, and the joy of the Mid-Autumn Festival!

Exciting Developments at HRUI in 2024
2024-12-31
As we close the curtain on 2024, we take a moment to reflect on the remarkable progress we've made as a company. Our strategic decisions, innovative spirit, and dedication to our employees have set the stage for a bright future.
GROWTH
This year marked a pivotal moment for HRUI with the successful relocation of our factory to the Zedali Industrial Park. This strategic move has not only boosted our production capacity and efficiency but has also optimized our entire manufacturing process, laying a solid foundation for future business expansion. Such initiatives align with our long-term goals and provide our employees with a better working environment.
Furthermore, we launched an all-encompassing online brand promotion platform, establishing comprehensive content across major platforms. This has significantly enhanced our brand influence and market coverage.
In addition, our investment in upgrading our SMT equipment in 2024 has resulted in the establishment of a new FUJI chip mounter line. Employing top-tier international brands for both production and testing equipment has greatly improved our production efficiency and quality compliance.
As our company continues to grow rapidly, our workforce has also expanded, surpassing 300 employees. This milestone signifies the strengthening of our team and provides robust talent support for our further business development.
INNOVATION
In line with our commitment to innovation, we officially launched the HRUI Cloud App, offering users convenient remote control and monitoring capabilities.
This year also saw the full-scale production of our advanced 2.5G and 10G lightweight managed switches. Thanks to our leading-edge research and development technology, we have achieved industry-leading shipping volumes, fulfilling the growing market demand for high-speed network devices and enhancing our competitive edge in the industry.
COLLABORATION
HRUI actively participated in various international exhibitions throughout the year, showcasing our latest products and technologies. Events included the 2024 Security Expo in the USA, Mexico, Poland, Vietnam, Germany, Europe, Turkey, Beijing, and Thailand. These exhibitions not only elevated our brand visibility but also facilitated the establishment of extensive international partnerships, further expanding our global market reach.
CARE
At HRUI, we believe in fostering a supportive work environment. To enhance team cohesion and employee well-being, we organized a series of engaging employee care activities, including outdoor team-building sessions, holiday parties, birthday celebrations, and afternoon teas. These initiatives reflect our commitment to employee growth and happiness, nurturing a harmonious workplace culture that strengthens team unity and enhances the sense of belonging among our employees.
As we embrace the future, we remain dedicated to delivering excellence, fostering innovation, and supporting our employees. We look forward to building on this year’s achievements and creating even more opportunities for growth and collaboration in the years to come.
Thank you for your continued support.
Sincerely,
The HRUI Team

HRUI Gigabit Managed Industrial PoE Switch
2025-03-03
The HRUI Gigabit managed industrial PoE switches offer a range of port configurations to suit various application requirements. Certain models support the IEEE 802.3af/at/bt standards, with select ports providing up to 90W PoE power for powering high-demanding PD devices.
These products provide robust L2+ management capabilities for enhanced control and operational flexibility. Furthermore, it supports HRUI cloud management, enabling convenient remote
monitoring and administration.
With the design of industrial-grade durability, these switches feature redundant power inputs for increased system reliability. The rugged IP40 aluminum alloy housing ensures efficient heat dissipation and the stable operation in a wide temperature range of -40°C to 75°C, which makes them suitable for extreme conditions. These switches are ideal for applications such as industrial automation, intelligent transportation systems, and security monitoring.
IEEE 802.3af/at/bt PoE Standard
These products use advanced PoE++ (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt) with up to 90W per port, ideal for high-power devices like wireless APs and PTZ cameras. They offer smart power management, real-time monitoring, and energy savings. Furthermore, they support SFP ports for fiber transmission up to 20km.
Integrated PoE Features for Managing PD
PoE Configuration
Provide configuration support for PoE settings, including parameters such as temperature, type, level, power, current, total PoE power budget management, PoE power control, port priority allocations, and individualized power limits for each PoE port. This thorough strategy will optimize PoE management, promote efficient resource utilization, and improve device reliability and performance.
PoE Schedule
Support for customizing the schedule to turn the PoE function on or off based on specific needs. This flexibility not only helps optimize energy consumption but also reduces operational costs, making it an efficient solution for energy management.
PoE Timer Management
Support rebooting the PoE function of port during a specified time. This will help reduce device crashes caused by buffer overflow, ensuring more reliable and stable performance during designated time intervals.
Supports L2+ Network Management
This product offers a comprehensive suite of L2+ network management features, including support for VLAN, port mirroring, traffic control, LACP, QoS, and DHCP Snooping, among others. It is designed to meet a variety of complex network requirements, enhancing network security, reliability, and scalability.
Unified Management in the Cloud: Accessible, Scalable, and Efficient
Provide cloud-based management for remote equipment monitoring and control, simplifying detection, configuration, deployment, and maintenance to reduce costs and improve efficiency and reliability.
Secure Networking
The products feature advanced cybersecurity measures, including SSHv2 and SNMPv3 protocols, to protect against cyber threats. Its robust security capabilities enhance switch management while maintaining cost-effective deployment for critical network operations.
Enhanced Fiber Module DDM Capabilities
Support for Fiber Module DDM (Digital Diagnostic Monitoring) includes tracking key parameters such as transceiver supply voltage, temperature, transmitter bias current, transmitter output power, and received optical power. By analyzing these metrics, you can effectively diagnose issues that may be affecting the transceiver optics performance.
Industrial Design Enabling Durable Applications
The products feature aluminum alloy casings, offering exceptional heat dissipation and mechanical strength. They are capable of stable operation across a broad temperature range (-40°C to 75°C), making them particularly suitable for application scenarios such as industrial sites and outdoor base stations.
Triple Power Input Design
The device features triple power inputs, enabling you to deploy multiple power sources for enhanced reliability and redundancy. This design guarantees that your system stays operational during power failures or unexpected shutdowns.

Urban Sewage Treatment And Control System Solution
2024-11-26
Scheme Introduction
Urban sewage treatment project is the life sewage, industrial wastewater for centralized collection, transmission, processing, discharge processing system, including transport along the discharge pipe network, sewage pumping station, sewage treatment plant, discharge, system monitoring and control center, etc., whole process is complex, large equipment, and various processing nodes scattered, large coverage, affected by external environment. Urban sewage treatment control system, the use of industrial Ethernet technology, stable and reliable connection of each process node sensor, controller, monitoring equipment, etc., to achieve the system of the entire sewage treatment system remote monitoring and comprehensive management.
Scheme Advantage
· Support optical fiber networking and photoelectric hybrid transmission, to achieve a large range, long distance, anti-interference network communication coverage.
· Open-race switching, full-line fast forwarding of products, to meet the requirements of large traffic, high bandwidth, low delay and other data transmission.
· Dual power redundancy design, in case of power failure, can ensure a more durable and stable power supply.
· A variety of ring network types, rich networking mode, to meet the needs of industrial networking and communication control, convenient network expansion.
· The loop network self-healing technology is adopted, and the loop network self-healing time is less than or equal to 12ms to ensure the rapid healing of the transmission network in case of link failure.
· Supports Bypass Bypass protection to avoid full resistance caused by single point of failure and improve network reliability.
· Industrial construction design, no fan, support DIN and rail mounting, strong protective housing, IP40 standard.
· Lightning and static, strong electromagnetic interference and surge resistance, working temperature: -40~85°C and adapts to various harsh environments.

Mid-Autumn Festival with Exciting Activities at HRUI
2024-11-27
In celebration of the Mid-Autumn Festival, HRUI is excited to announce a half-day event packed with engaging activities meant to honor this traditional holiday and strengthen team spirit among employees. The festivities will take place from September 9 to 10, 2024, at the HRUI offices, running from 4:40 PM to 6:30 PM.
This year's celebration promises a mix of intellectual challenges and fun games, including:
Chinese Lantern Riddle:
Participants will put their wits to the test with cleverly crafted riddles displayed on beautiful lanterns, bringing a sense of nostalgia and excitement to the evening.
Tossing the Hu:
Employees will demonstrate their skills in this traditional Chinese game, where contestants aim to toss wooden sticks into a pot. Prizes will be awarded to the most accurate throwers!
The Order of the Flying Flower:
This lively competition invites participants to recite lines from classical poetry at a fast pace, encouraging creativity and quick thinking while celebrating Chinese literature.
Guess What:
Teams will enjoy a light-hearted guessing game where they must identify famous quotes from popular movies and TV shows.
Legend and Story Gathering:
Attendees can listen to ancient legends associated with the festival, appreciating the rich culture and history that spans a thousand years.
The event will also feature delicious mooncakes and refreshments, allowing everyone to soak in the festive atmosphere and connect with colleagues from various departments.
“We are thrilled to bring the spirit of the Mid-Autumn Festival to HRUI,” said Yang, Marketing Supervisor. “This event not only celebrates our cultural heritage but also strengthens our company culture by encouraging teamwork, creativity, and a bit of friendly competition.”
All employees are encouraged to take part in the activities, with prizes and recognition awarded to the winners of each challenge, ensuring a fun and memorable celebration. Join us as we celebrate unity, creativity, and the joy of the Mid-Autumn Festival!

Exciting Developments at HRUI in 2024
2024-12-31
As we close the curtain on 2024, we take a moment to reflect on the remarkable progress we've made as a company. Our strategic decisions, innovative spirit, and dedication to our employees have set the stage for a bright future.
GROWTH
This year marked a pivotal moment for HRUI with the successful relocation of our factory to the Zedali Industrial Park. This strategic move has not only boosted our production capacity and efficiency but has also optimized our entire manufacturing process, laying a solid foundation for future business expansion. Such initiatives align with our long-term goals and provide our employees with a better working environment.
Furthermore, we launched an all-encompassing online brand promotion platform, establishing comprehensive content across major platforms. This has significantly enhanced our brand influence and market coverage.
In addition, our investment in upgrading our SMT equipment in 2024 has resulted in the establishment of a new FUJI chip mounter line. Employing top-tier international brands for both production and testing equipment has greatly improved our production efficiency and quality compliance.
As our company continues to grow rapidly, our workforce has also expanded, surpassing 300 employees. This milestone signifies the strengthening of our team and provides robust talent support for our further business development.
INNOVATION
In line with our commitment to innovation, we officially launched the HRUI Cloud App, offering users convenient remote control and monitoring capabilities.
This year also saw the full-scale production of our advanced 2.5G and 10G lightweight managed switches. Thanks to our leading-edge research and development technology, we have achieved industry-leading shipping volumes, fulfilling the growing market demand for high-speed network devices and enhancing our competitive edge in the industry.
COLLABORATION
HRUI actively participated in various international exhibitions throughout the year, showcasing our latest products and technologies. Events included the 2024 Security Expo in the USA, Mexico, Poland, Vietnam, Germany, Europe, Turkey, Beijing, and Thailand. These exhibitions not only elevated our brand visibility but also facilitated the establishment of extensive international partnerships, further expanding our global market reach.
CARE
At HRUI, we believe in fostering a supportive work environment. To enhance team cohesion and employee well-being, we organized a series of engaging employee care activities, including outdoor team-building sessions, holiday parties, birthday celebrations, and afternoon teas. These initiatives reflect our commitment to employee growth and happiness, nurturing a harmonious workplace culture that strengthens team unity and enhances the sense of belonging among our employees.
As we embrace the future, we remain dedicated to delivering excellence, fostering innovation, and supporting our employees. We look forward to building on this year’s achievements and creating even more opportunities for growth and collaboration in the years to come.
Thank you for your continued support.
Sincerely,
The HRUI Team

Showcasing Innovation: HRUI Unveils Advanced PoE Switch Solutions at Security China 2024
2024-11-27
From October 22 to 25, 2024, the 2024 China International Public Security Products Expo (referred to as Beijing Public Security Expo) successfully took place at the China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi Pavilion) in Beijing. During this event, HRUI showcased her latest developed series of PoE switches at booth E3D29, demonstrating the technological depth and outstanding performance of its products across various application scenarios.
The key products series on display at the exhibition are as follows:
The HRUI Commercial PoE switch series complies with IEEE 802.3 af/at/bt standards and offers flexible port configurations, providing 5 to 28 ports and supporting speeds from 100 Mbps to 10 Gbps. With a professional design and reliable structure, this series has passed certifications such as CE, FCC, and RoHS, and is widely used across various industries to meet diverse network requirements.
The HRUI industrial Ethernet/PoE switch series features industrial components and high-standard design, with an IP40 protection rating. It is equipped with shock resistance, anti-static protection, protection against network interference, and surge/ESD protection. The switches support BT90W PoE, 2.5G, ERPS, and Bypass functions. They are designed with redundant power supplies and support DIN rail and wall-mounted installation, with an operating temperature range of -40°C to +75°C, making them suitable for complex industrial communication environments.
The HRUI commercial L2+/L3 Ethernet/PoE switch series supports 10G high-speed connections and features L2+/L3 network management, PoE time management, ERPS, and multiple other functions. The products are equipped with comprehensive security control and network protection mechanisms, facilitating integration with customer and third-party NMS platforms. They are widely used in aggregation and core medium-to-large networks, helping to build stable, reliable, and easily manageable data communication networks.
With the rapid development of the internet and the continuous evolution of technology, the demand for network speed is on the rise. Against this backdrop, HRUI has proudly launched a series of innovative 2.5G/10G smart web managed switches. These switches provide a comprehensive combination of optical, electrical, and mixed optical-electrical ports, effectively meeting the needs of different users such as businesses, data centers, and home networks. With this set of lightweight managed switches, users can easily tackle various challenges posed by future networks, thereby creating a more efficient network environment.
Wireless products, as essential devices that connect two or more wireless networks, can efficiently expand network coverage and reduce wiring costs, especially demonstrating their unique advantages in environments where it is difficult to lay wired networks. This year, HRUI has also launched corresponding product lines, and provided customers with detailed product explanations and demonstrations on-site.
At this exhibition, HRUI showcased her developed intelligent cloud management platform to the industry. This platform integrates multiple functions, including network management, real-time monitoring, and various network testing tools, helping enterprises achieve efficient resource allocation and operational management. No matter where you are, you can easily take full control of your company's dynamics and make quick decisions with just one click.
In closing, the 2024 China International Public Security Products Expo served as a successful launch pad for HRUI's latest innovations, reinforcing her position in the network infrastructure industry. With ongoing investments in research and development and a focus on customer needs, HRUI is not just responding to current trends but actively driving the evolution of network technology.
